nodes.label: Farasa Diacritization Engine for Modern Standard Arabic
nodes.description: Recurrent neural network and character-level bi-LSTM module for high-precision automatic diacritization and vowel restoration in Modern Standard Arabic text.

nodes.label: PCIe Component Measurement and IDE (Integrity and Data Encryption) Protocol
nodes.description: PCI-SIG hardware protocol providing confidentiality, integrity, and anti-replay protection for transaction layer packets (TLPs) over PCIe links.

nodes.label: HDT (Header, Dictionary, Triples) Binary RDF Representation Standard
nodes.description: Binary structure for serializing RDF data that compresses datasets using dictionary encoding and bit-oriented graph structures while enabling direct SPARQL evaluation without decompression.

nodes.label: IETF Hybrid Post-Quantum X.509 Public Key Infrastructure Certificate Standard
nodes.description: IETF LAMPS specification defining multi-key and composite signature formats in X.509 certificates to support dual classical (RSA/ECC) and post-quantum (ML-DSA) validation.

nodes.label: GraphBLAS Algebraic Bellman-Ford Single-Source Shortest Path Algorithm
nodes.description: Parallel shortest path graph traversal algorithm formulated via matrix-vector multiplication over the tropical (min-plus) semiring in GraphBLAS.
